owner_sentences.sentence: Không phê chuẩn 'miền A' chỉ dựa vào tên phương án.
owner_sentences.evidence: Domain A is tested against the principle, not the name: the reader (format3.reconstruct) folds no projection; BASE verify returned VERIFIED + delivery PASS for a chained, schema-valid journal that commits twice or commits with no admission (re-run with the boundary disabled: journal_events 8 and 10); the projections admit a committed attempt that observed failures (re-run enumeration: 18,952 of 100,337 admitted one-story journals break INV-A).

owner_sentences.sentence: Tôi chọn nguyên tắc: Miền hành vi phải bao phủ mọi journal hợp lệ mà các đường sản phẩm được hỗ trợ có thể đưa đến no_progress, gồm run, continue, verify và import/migrate nếu có.
owner_sentences.evidence: Callers of no_progress: run.py:495 and verify.py:194 only (grep over aisef, aisef2, bin, validation, docs). Continue: the child's own fresh journal; bundle continue/lineage.events_of/repair/sentinel read journals and never reach it. No import path exists; bundle migrate reads and writes bundles. 'Valid' is defined as admitted by the six projections (the writer's Authority); the function answers every such journal (enumeration, re-run one story <= 10 events: new == independent oracle on 100,337; tests in test_v21_r3_usage_no_progress). Residual: late failures (D-LATE) are answered by ignoring them, a choice the owner may revisit.

owner_sentences.sentence: Journal không hợp lệ phải được kiểm tra và từ chối ở ranh giới xác định.
owner_sentences.evidence: verify._projection_refusal folds the six PROJECTIONS (Folder.advance, the writer's own step) right after reconstruct; first refusal -> one REFUTED finding naming projection, event type, seq and reason; journal_events 0. 8 refusal classes tested through real verify and the CLI (exit 1); my extra test shows it holds for a record with no usage account. The other readers (bundle continue, lineage.events_of, repair) do not refuse; none reaches no_progress (D-READERS stays open).

owner_sentences.sentence: Đối chiếu nguyên tắc này với hồ sơ mutation/no_progress-13-23.md.
owner_sentences.evidence: Decision doc §2 checks each dossier claim; I re-checked F1 (BASE kill_check: 33 mutants, 31 KILLED, 13 and 23 SURVIVED), F2 (_fail is the only writer of failure/observed), F3 (projections admit failure then commit), F4 (BASE verify VERIFIED+PASS), F5 (two callers).

owner_sentences.sentence: Nếu miền A đáp ứng thì áp dụng và ghi rõ phạm vi. Nếu không, sửa đề xuất theo nguyên tắc trên.
owner_sentences.evidence: A does not satisfy the principle; the proposal was revised: commit is no longer a closer, a story/begin clears what the story observed since its last outcome, and verify refuses what the projections refuse. No verify-only rule (INV-A is answered by the function).

owner_sentences.sentence: Không dùng 'kernel hiện tại không sinh ra' làm căn cứ duy nhất để loại một đầu vào mà reader vẫn chấp nhận.
owner_sentences.evidence: Every input the reader accepts is either answered by no_progress (projection-admitted) or refused by name at verify (projection-refused); none is excluded because the story runner does not write it. The one premise left (no event of type '') is the reader's refusal in every format, tested (EmptyType) with a faithful-encoder control.

owner_sentences.sentence: Không xem thử nhiều journal là chứng minh tương đương.
owner_sentences.evidence: No equivalence is claimed from sampling. The enumeration is labelled conformance evidence against a second statement of the requirement by the same author; the behaviour is pinned by tests that fail on wrong implementations (re-run). The no-false-refusal claim rests on a structural argument I re-derived (projections, reader and run_scope byte-identical 2.0.0..BASE; no commit between 6b0b90d and ca26313 touched them; every writer path goes through Authority) plus the sample (671 admitted, 0 false).

owner_sentences.sentence: Hai mutant phải được kiểm chứng hành vi hoặc có hồ sơ tương đương đủ căn cứ, không tính thành KILLED nếu chỉ được audit.
owner_sentences.evidence: 13 and 23 are dissolved by the product change and counted as neither KILLED nor AUDITED; the behaviour they stood for is pinned (BASE-like function fails 4 of 14 no_progress test methods, 8 failures with subtests; a function that compares with any earlier attempt was NOT caught until the review test). The changed function's 35 mutants are 35 KILLED (re-run). The lead retires the two rows on re-measurement.

defects_found.what: Test gap: no_progress comparing with any earlier failed attempt instead of the attempt before passes every test of the WP and of the registered kill files (the runner's catalogue cannot generate it)

Test gap: a verify boundary placed inside the V2.1 usage branch passes every boundary test, because every record they build carries usage; the decision doc says the boundary is at the reconstruction step so a 2.0.0 record is refused too
Decision doc: '8 of 14 tests fail on BASE' is 4 of 14 methods (8 failures with subtests)
Decision doc: the fold is described as linear; it is quadratic in the number of stories (measured)

tests/v2/test_v21_kills3_R05.py:15 still says no_progress 13 and 23 are not tested and 'the owner has not ruled (OPEN)': false after this change. Not edited (a registered kill file: editing its bytes may stale records that bind it).

verify cost on a forged journal: the fold is quadratic, so a journal of ~100k story events can cost hours where verify was linear before; the writer pays the same, so an honest run never exceeds its own journaling cost. Not a defect of correctness; there is no bound on verify time.

counter_examples: no_progress, wrong implementation 'compare with any earlier failed attempt': U retry, T retry, U rollback -> reports attempt 3 (correct: []); passed all 47 tests of the WP + registered kill files before the review test
verify, wrong implementation 'refusal only inside the V2.1 usage branch': a record without usage whose journal commits with no admission is VERIFIED + PASS; passed all boundary tests

no_progress, late failure joins the attempt it followed (D-LATE option C): fails 7 of 47 tests incl. 2 pre-existing begin-less list tests (my quick implementation lacks the pre-scan the implementer describes) - the tests pin 'ignored', as the doc says
no_progress, 'commit pops the attempt's failures but adds no row': passes all 47 tests; equivalent on every projection-admitted journal (nothing follows a commit)

remaining_risks: D-LATE: the late-failure answer (ignored) differs from the projections' attribution (previous attempt) on shapes no producer writes; in the one-story model 368 of the 384 BASE/new differences are this class, 16 are the commit class.
D-READERS: bundle continue, lineage.events_of, repair, sentinel still do not refuse a projection-violating journal (none reaches no_progress).
D-INVA: a commit with an open failure in its attempt stays admitted by the projections; the function answers it, the journal format still allows it.
Quadratic verify cost (see defects): no bound on verify time for a large or forged journal.
Consistency, not authenticity: without --expect-anchor an admitted, consistent rewrite still verifies.
Windows and Python 3.11/3.13 not run (3.12 and 3.14 on macOS, 3.14 in the Linux guest). Journals of kernels before 2.0.0 not checked.
The 11 verify survivors are the campaign's, audited against BASE's source hash; those audits are stale until the lead remaps them.
The late failure and commit semantic choices change RUN.json only for shapes outside the story runner's grammar; none of 673 journals found changes.
decisions_needed: D-LATE (owner): keep 'a failure journaled between an outcome and the next story/begin is nobody's' or attach it to the attempt it followed. Review reading: both are defined; ignoring matches what the retry decision saw and what failure_owner keeps as the deciding failure.
D-READERS (owner): must bundle continue / lineage.events_of / repair also refuse a projection-violating journal (helper would move to aisef2/journal)?
D-INVA (owner): should 'failure then commit in one attempt' be impossible in the journal (projection change, version bump)?
VERIFY-COST (owner/lead): accept quadratic verify cost, or bound it (cap on events/stories, or a cheaper fold)?

REGISTER (lead): kill files - usage.py::no_progress += tests/v2/test_v21_r3_usage_no_progress.py (+ tests/v2/test_v21_r3_usage_review.py for the 'any earlier attempt' wrong implementation); verify.py::_projection_refusal = tests/v2/test_v21_r3_usage_boundary.py; verify.py::verify += tests/v2/test_v21_r3_usage_boundary.py (+ test_v21_r3_usage_review.py). Retire rows 13 and 23 on re-measurement; remap the 11 stale verify audits.
